title: The Hidden Giant: Plastic Crisis in Research Labs
description: Discover the shocking statistics of laboratory plastic waste and explore how the pursuit of knowledge impacts our planet.

stages.title: The Bench Reality
stages.content: A typical lab bench looks clean, but it's the source of a massive waste stream. Pipette tips, tubes, and dishes—mostly single-use.
stages.interaction: Click the lab items to see their annual waste contribution.

stages.title: 5.5 Million Tons
stages.content: Globally, research labs generate 5.5 million metric tons of plastic waste annually. That is roughly 2% of the world's total plastic waste!
stages.interaction: Drag to see the pile of plastic grow to the size of a mountain.

stages.title: The Scientist's Footprint
stages.content: One single scientist can generate up to 100kg of plastic waste per year. That's 12 times more than a typical office worker.
stages.interaction: Balance the 'Lab Waste' vs 'Office Waste' on the digital scale.

stages.title: Into the Deep Ocean
stages.content: Since lab plastics are often contaminated, they are landfilled or incinerated, leaking microplastics into the food chain and oceans.
stages.interaction: Simulate the fragmentation of a Petri dish into micro-particles.

stages.title: Be the Change
stages.content: Knowledge shouldn't come at the cost of the Earth. Support the 'Green Lab' movement with eduNest and rethink research habits.
stages.interaction: Review the summary and commit to a sustainable future.

parent_guidance: Look honey, even small things like these tips add up. Can you help count how many are on the bench?

Even the smartest people in the world need to learn how to be greener. What's one thing we can recycle today?
